messages.en:

to do some cleaning around
here, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Why don't you come by, say,
tomorrow, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 04 00}Vabandust!{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma üritan siin
ikka veel natuke
koristada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}My room is a mess. {01 00 00 05 00}I can't
even offer you a snack,
'cuz I can't find my fridge!
{07 16 00}Look, I'm sorry, but I'm
going to have to ask you
to go{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} It's too messy!

messages.et:
{07 06 00}Mu tuba on segamini. {01 00 00 05 00}Ma ei
saa sulle isegi suupistet
pakkuda, külmkappi pole!
{07 16 00}Vaata, vabandust, aga ma
pean sul paluma
minna{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Liiga sassis!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I'm so sorry, but I've got
a lot of unpacking to do,
and I want to finish today.
Would you mind {07 0b 00}dropping by
tomorrow, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 16 00}I'm not really ready to, you
know, entertain guests or
anything, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mul on nii kahju, aga mul on
palju lahtipakkimist ja ma
tahan täna lõpetada.
Kas sa võiksid {07 0b 00}homme
läbi astuda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 16 00}Ma pole päriselt valmis,
tead küll, külalisi võtma
või midagi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Wow! Company! And I haven't
even finished unpacking.
What a nice town this is!
{07 0a 00}I'm{01 00 00 0a 00} so happy that
I moved{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Vau! Külalised! Ja ma pole
isegi lahti pakkinud.
Milline kena linn see on!
{07 0a 00}Ma olen{01 00 00 0a 00} nii õnnelik, et
ma kolisin{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
